sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It's a rainy day.
sentences.zh: 今天是个下雨天。

sentences.en: Very, very gloomy, rainy day.
sentences.zh: 非常、非常阴郁的下雨天。

sentences.en: And it's a little loud because you have to keep the windows open.
sentences.zh: 而且有点吵，因为你得开着窗户。

sentences.en: That's the recommendation in these situations.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这是建议的做法。

sentences.en: You have to keep everything ventilated.
sentences.zh: 你必须保持一切通风。

sentences.en: Two weeks ago, our researcher Elsie and I went down to Wuhan, which is this major city in the center of China that has been the epicenter of the recent coronavirus outbreak.
sentences.zh: 两周前，我们的研究员埃尔西和我去了武汉，这是中国中部的一座主要城市，也是最近冠状病毒疫情的震中。

sentences.en: By then, it had been under lockdown for about a week, and we were really curious to see how people were faring and what was going on, especially at the hospitals there.
sentences.zh: 到那时，它已经被封锁大约一周了，我们很好奇人们过得怎么样，发生了什么，尤其是那里的医院。

sentences.en: We took the train from Beijing to Wuhan and we got off and what we saw was totally crazy.
sentences.zh: 我们坐火车从北京到武汉，下了车，看到的景象简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I mean, we've never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们从未见过这样的景象。

sentences.en: This is a city of 11 million that had come to a complete standstill.
sentences.zh: 这是一座拥有1100万人口的城市，已经完全陷入停顿。

sentences.en: It felt like being in a parallel reality.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像身处平行现实中一样。

sentences.en: To see those streets completely empty was really striking.
sentences.zh: 看到那些街道空无一人，真的让人震撼。

sentences.en: It was eerie to hear the silence.
sentences.zh: 听到这种寂静令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: And the only time we heard anything was the occasional barking of a dog or an ambulance passing by.
sentences.zh: 我们唯一能听到的声音，就是偶尔传来的狗叫声或救护车的呼啸而过。

sentences.en: We were walking around this hospital and we walked into the courtyard in front of the outpatient department.
sentences.zh: 我们在医院周围走着，走进了门诊部前面的庭院。

sentences.en: And that's where we came upon this very jarring scene.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，我们遇到了这个非常刺眼的场景。

sentences.en: You had 30 or so patients that were all kind of sitting quietly in the courtyard, all hooked up to IV drips that were hanging from tree ranches or in their cars.
sentences.zh: 大约有30名患者安静地坐在院子里，所有人都挂着从树枝上垂下或在车里的静脉输液瓶。

sentences.en: We meet this mother and her two children who are all hooked up to Ivs. The mother's name is Yang Ming.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了这位母亲和她的两个孩子，他们都挂着点滴。母亲名叫杨明。

sentences.en: They tell me that they are actually a family of six.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，他们其实是一个六口之家。

sentences.en: There's Yang Ming, there's her husband, her husband's parents, and then their son and their daughter.
sentences.zh: 有杨明、她的丈夫、她丈夫的父母，还有他们的儿子和女儿。

sentences.en: And they have all been staying together.
sentences.zh: 他们一直待在一起。

sentences.en: And she tells us that the grandmother got sick firSt. And one by one, each of them has gotten infected by the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，奶奶最先生病。然后他们一个接一个地感染了冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And now her husband is the only one that doesn't have coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 现在她丈夫是唯一没有感染冠状病毒的人。

sentences.en: And then they tell me that just one week after the grandmother started showing symptoms, their grandfather died.
sentences.zh: 然后他们告诉我，就在奶奶开始出现症状仅仅一周后，他们的爷爷就去世了。

sentences.en: She tells us that after the grandfather dies, the funeral home comes to take the body away.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，爷爷死后，殡仪馆来把尸体运走了。

sentences.en: And he is cremated immediately.
sentences.zh: 并且立即被火化了。

sentences.en: And she says that he was taken away just like a dead dog or a dead pig.
sentences.zh: 她说他被带走的时候就像一只死狗或死猪一样。

sentences.en: As she's talking, her voice is starting to carry across the courtyard outside this hospital.
sentences.zh: 她说话时，声音开始在这个医院外的院子里传开。

sentences.en: And other people are starting to listen in and crowd around us.
sentences.zh: 其他人开始倾听并聚集在我们周围。

sentences.en: And she's starting to get more and more upset.
sentences.zh: 她开始变得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: She was so palpably angry that at one point, the mother was waving her arms around in frustration and almost ripped the IV needle out of her hand.
sentences.zh: 她是如此明显地愤怒，以至于有一刻，这位母亲沮丧地挥舞着手臂，差一点把手上的输液针扯掉。

sentences.en: I've been covering China for seven years, and I've heard people express frustrations with the government before, but really only in private.
sentences.zh: 我报道中国七年了，以前也听人表达过对政府的不满，但真的只在私下里。

sentences.en: This was one of the few times that I've heard such raw anger toward the government publicly.
sentences.zh: 这是我为数不多的公开听到对政府如此强烈愤怒的时刻之一。

sentences.en: She basically says, is this really my country?
sentences.zh: 她基本上是在说，这真的是我的国家吗？

sentences.en: Or is this some kind of fucked up country?
sentences.zh: 还是这是一个他妈的什么鬼国家？

sentences.en: A country that doesn't take care of anything?
sentences.zh: 一个什么都不管的国家？

sentences.en: And then she says, what kind of government is this?
sentences.zh: 然后她说，这是什么政府？

sentences.en: And after hearing that, that made me think that something was happening that was bigger than just an outbreak of a virus.
sentences.zh: 听到这些，我开始觉得有什么事情正在发生，这不仅仅是一场病毒爆发那么简单。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, inside China, what began as a story of fear over the coronavirus has now become the story of fury over the government's handling of the crisis.
sentences.zh: 今天，走进中国，最初关于对冠状病毒恐惧的故事，现在已经变成了对政府处理危机方式愤怒的故事。

sentences.en: Beijing correspondent Amy Chen on what she saw in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 北京分社记者艾米·陈讲述她在武汉的所见所闻。

sentences.en: It's Thursday,
sentences.zh: 今天是星期四，

sentences.en: February 13th.
Amy, what is it about this moment that you think is making people like the Zhang family
sentences.zh: 艾米，你认为是什么让张家人这样的时刻

sentences.en: feel free to speak out about their anger and to pretty explicitly criticize the Chinese government?
sentences.zh: 感到可以自由地表达他们的愤怒，并相当明确地批评中国政府？

sentences.en: So for the Zhang family, this is for them a matter of life or death.
sentences.zh: 所以对于张家人来说，对他们来说这是生死攸关的问题。

sentences.en: And it was a common feeling I heard throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 这也是我在整个城市听到的一种普遍感受。

sentences.en: But there's another added frustration boiling across the rest of the country about how the government is handling this crisis.
sentences.zh: 但在全国其他地方，关于政府如何处理这场危机，还有另一种额外的沮丧情绪在沸腾。

sentences.en: And for them, it's really been captured in the story of this doctor named Dr. Li Wenliang.
sentences.zh: 对他们而言，这确实体现在这位名叫李文亮医生的故事中。

sentences.en: And who is this doctor?
sentences.zh: 这位医生是谁？

sentences.en: So Li Wenliang is an eye doctor at a hospital in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 所以李文亮是武汉一家医院的眼科医生。

sentences.en: And he had heard about this virus back in December that was going around the hospitals in the city.
sentences.zh: 他早在12月就听说这种病毒正在该市的医院里传播。

sentences.en: And so he went on WeChat, which is this big social messaging platform, and sent in a private
sentences.zh: 于是他上了微信，这是一个大型社交消息平台，在与一些医学院同学的私人

sentences.en: messaging group with some of his med school classmates, a text message basically warning them to protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 聊天群里发了一条短信，基本上是警告他们保护自己。

sentences.en: And a few days later, after he sent that message, he was actually called in by the police in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 在他发送该消息几天后，他实际上被武汉警方传唤了。

sentences.en: They brought him into the police station and they made him sign a statement saying that he was spreading false and illegal information, basically that he was spreading rumors.
sentences.zh: 他们把他带到警察局，让他签署一份声明，称他在传播虚假和非法信息，基本上是在散布谣言。

sentences.en: Authorities say it is untrue and eight people were detained for spreading fake news online and no medical staff had been infected.
sentences.zh: 当局表示这是不实的，八人因在网上散布假新闻而被拘留，没有医务人员感染。

sentences.en: But of course, it wasn't a rumor.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这不是谣言。

sentences.en: Chinese health authorities are still working to identify the virus behind a pneumonia outbreak in the central city of Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 中国卫生当局仍在努力确定中部城市武汉肺炎疫情背后的病毒。

sentences.en: By the time Dr. Li was brought into the police station, 41 people had the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 在李医生被带到警察局时，已有41人感染了冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And from there, it just spread.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，它就开始蔓延。

sentences.en: A SARS-like virus, which has infected hundreds in China, has now reached the United
sentences.zh: 一种类似非典的病毒已感染中国数百人，现已蔓延至美国

sentences.en: States.
sentences.zh: 合众国。

sentences.en: Now, China has announced the first death from an outbreak of pneumonia caused by an unidentified virus.
sentences.zh: 现在，中国宣布了不明病毒引起的肺炎疫情导致的首例死亡病例。

sentences.en: 121 people are under medical observation in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 121人在武汉接受医学观察。

sentences.en: Rumors on social media alleged that the outbreak in Wuhan could be linked to SARS.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上的传言称，武汉的疫情可能与非典有关。

sentences.en: The health organization says it's a new type of coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 卫生组织称这是一种新型冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And Amy, at this point, what is happening to Dr. Li?
sentences.zh: 艾米，目前李医生怎么样了？

sentences.en: So after Dr. Li gets taken into the police station and forced to sign this statement, he was actually treating a patient for glaucoma.
sentences.zh: 所以在李医生被带到警察局并被迫签署这份声明后，他其实正在为一名青光眼患者进行治疗。

sentences.en: And she wasn't showing any symptoms at the time, but he ended up contracting the virus from her.
sentences.zh: 她当时没有任何症状，但他最终还是从她那里感染了病毒。

sentences.en: And from his sickbed, he starts to speak out again.
sentences.zh: 从病榻上，他再次开始发声。

sentences.en: In a matter of days, Dr. Li Wenliang went from treating patients to becoming one.
sentences.zh: 在短短几天内，李文亮医生从治疗患者变成了患者。

sentences.en: He gives some interviews to Chinese media, and he starts to become this public figure.
sentences.zh: 他接受了中国媒体的一些采访，并开始成为这个公众人物。

sentences.en: Struggling to communicate, Li spoke with CNN briefly by phone.
sentences.zh: 李艰难地进行交流，简短地通过电话接受了CNN的采访。

sentences.en: You can hear the hospital machines pulsing in the background.
sentences.zh: 你能听到背景中医院机器的跳动声。

sentences.en: He becomes known as a whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 他被称为吹哨人。

sentences.en: Silenced by police.
sentences.zh: 被警方噤声。

sentences.en: Calls for Li and the others to be vindicated grew online.
sentences.zh: 网络上要求为李和其他人平反的呼声越来越高。

sentences.en: That the government didn't act fast enough on information that they were given, and that they had missed this critical window of opportunity to get the outbreak under control.
sentences.zh: 政府对提供给他们的信息行动不够快，他们错过了控制疫情的关键窗口期。

sentences.en: — China's Supreme Court even weighed in, adding, quote, it might have been a fortunate thing if the public had listened to this rumor at the time.
sentences.zh: ——中国最高法院甚至权衡了此事，并引述称，如果当时公众听信了这个谣言，可能是一件幸运的事。

sentences.en: But for many—
sentences.zh: 但对许多人来说——

sentences.en: — So he's becoming a kind of spokesperson for a lot of frustrations.
sentences.zh: ——所以他正在成为许多沮丧情绪的一种代言人。

sentences.en: — Exactly.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: — And so at this point, it just feels like there's no light at the end of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: ——所以在这一点上，感觉隧道尽头没有一丝光亮。

sentences.en: — Now the death toll and the outbreak of a new coronavirus in China has jumped to 17.
sentences.zh: ——现在中国新型冠状病毒疫情的死亡人数已跃升至17人。

sentences.en: — Hundreds of people have been diagnosed with a deadly virus known as the 2019.
sentences.zh: ——数百人被诊断出感染了被称为2019年的致命病毒。

sentences.en: — Overall, there are now more than 31,500 confirmed cases worldwide.
sentences.zh: ——总体而言，全球确诊病例现已超过31,500例。

sentences.en: — More and more people are getting sick.
sentences.zh: ——越来越多的人生病了。

sentences.en: We're seeing the numbers just surge every day.
sentences.zh: 我们看到数字每天都在激增。

sentences.en: — 600 deaths.
— People who are confirmed cases of the coronavirus, people who are dying of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: ——确诊感染冠状病毒的人，死于冠状病毒的人。

sentences.en: — Has jumped to more than 700.
sentences.zh: ——已跃升至700多人。

sentences.en: — Everything felt so uncertain.
sentences.zh: ——一切都感觉那么不确定。

sentences.en: — Officials are imposing restrictions on travel out of Wuhan, China.
sentences.zh: ——官员们正在对离开中国武汉的旅行实施限制。

sentences.en: — And 13 cities in lockdown this morning.
sentences.zh: ——今天早晨有13个城市处于封锁状态。

sentences.en: — Near empty shelves line supermarkets.
sentences.zh: ——超市货架几近空空如也。

sentences.en: — A need for masks and protective suits.
sentences.zh: ——对口罩和防护服的需求。

sentences.en: — China's health minister, Ma Xiaowei, has said that he expects infections to continue to rise.
sentences.zh: ——中国国家卫生健康委员会主任马晓伟表示，他预计感染人数将继续上升。

sentences.en: And of course, that has everyone here in the country even more nervous.
sentences.zh: 当然，这让国内的每个人都更加紧张。

sentences.en: — The citizens are actually freaking out.
sentences.zh: ——市民们实际上吓坏了。

sentences.en: — China right now is being massively rocked by anger.
sentences.zh: ——中国现在正被愤怒巨大地撼动。

sentences.en: — And the State Department has said it is chartering a flight to evacuate Americans out of
sentences.zh: ——国务院表示正在包机将美国人从

sentences.en: Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 武汉撤离。

sentences.en: Justin, though, will not be on that.
sentences.zh: 不过，贾斯汀不会在那架飞机上。

sentences.en: — So foreign governments started pulling their citizens out of Wuhan, and that's when I got the call.
sentences.zh: ——所以外国政府开始将他们的公民撤出武汉，就在那时我接到了电话。

sentences.en: So it was late last week, and I'd been on the phone all day with my editors, and I get a final call saying, you need to go to the airport.
sentences.zh: 那是上周晚些时候，我整天都在和编辑通电话，然后我接到最后一个电话，说你需要去机场。

sentences.en: — There was one flight left that was being arranged by the U.S.
sentences.zh: ——美国正在安排最后一架航班

sentences.en: State Department to go back to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 国务院返回美国。

sentences.en: — So I started scrambling.
sentences.zh: ——所以我开始手忙脚乱。

sentences.en: I leave all my masks, my disinfectant wipes, my hazmat suit, my gloves with my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我把所有的口罩、消毒湿巾、防护服、手套都留给了同事。

sentences.en: And then it's about a 40-minute drive to the airport.
sentences.zh: 开车去机场大约需要40分钟。

sentences.en: — Okay, so I am at the airport in Wuhan now, and it's been a crazy, hectic day.
sentences.zh: ——好的，我现在在武汉机场，这是疯狂而忙碌的一天。

sentences.en: — I think that the next few weeks in quarantine on a military base will bring its own
sentences.zh: ——我认为在军事基地隔离的接下来几周

sentences.en: interesting moments.
sentences.zh: 会带来它自己的有趣时刻。

sentences.en: — And what is the scene at the airport?
sentences.zh: ——机场的场景是怎样的？

sentences.en: — The scene at the airport was a little bit frenzied.
sentences.zh: ——机场的场景有点狂乱。

sentences.en: I mean, at this point, these are really some of the last flights out for these countries who are evacuating their citizens.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在这一点上，这些确实是撤离公民的国家最后的几个航班。

sentences.en: So it wasn't just the Americans.
sentences.zh: 所以不只是美国人。

sentences.en: There were also the Canadians, the Japanese.
sentences.zh: 还有加拿大人、日本人。

sentences.en: We didn't even know at that point where they were taking us to.
sentences.zh: 我们当时甚至不知道他们要带我们去哪里。

sentences.en: — So I'm in the airport lobby, and I'm waiting for my flight.
sentences.zh: ——所以我现在在机场大厅，等待我的航班。

sentences.en: And then my phone starts to buzz, and I'm seeing all these messages come through.
sentences.zh: 然后我的手机开始震动，我看到所有这些消息涌进来。

sentences.en: And I look at them, and then I see that Dr. Lee has just died.
sentences.zh: 我看了看，然后看到李医生刚刚去世。

sentences.en: And I could sense that this was going to be a big moment because I had started overhearing people talking about it in the airport terminal.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到这将是一个重大时刻，因为我开始无意中听到机场航站楼里的人们在谈论它。

sentences.en: But then I just had to leave.
sentences.zh: 但随后我不得不离开。

sentences.en: I had to get on the flight.
sentences.zh: 我必须登机。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: ——我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: ——《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请今天下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: — So Amy, Dr. Lee has died from the very virus that he alerted the government to.
sentences.zh: ——所以艾米，李医生死于他曾向政府发出警告的同一种病毒。

sentences.en: And you're on a plane back to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而你正坐着飞机从武汉

sentences.en: from Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 返回美国。

sentences.en: So what happens once you land?
sentences.zh: 那么你着陆之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: — So once I land, I find that I am at the Miramar Marine Base in San Diego, California.
sentences.zh: — 所以一旦我着陆，我发现自己来到了加利福尼亚州圣迭戈的米拉马尔海军陆战队基地。

sentences.en: I'm carted off to quarantine.
sentences.zh: 我被送到隔离区。

sentences.en: And then I turn on my phone and I start going through my messages.
sentences.zh: 然后我打开手机，开始查看我的消息。

sentences.en: And I see this huge upswalling of outrage over Dr. Lee's death.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们对李医生的死产生了巨大的愤怒浪潮。

sentences.en: People from every stripe of the political or social spectrum in China.
sentences.zh: 中国政治或社会谱系中各行各业的人。

sentences.en: So you have people who are business people who are blue collar workers, artists, lawyers.
sentences.zh: 所以你有商人、蓝领工人、艺术家、律师。

sentences.en: They're all posting about Dr. Lee's death.
sentences.zh: 他们都在发帖悼念李医生的死。

sentences.en: And I've never seen people come together like this before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未见过人们这样团结在一起。

sentences.en: And then people were so upset about his death.
sentences.zh: 然后人们对他的死感到非常难过。

sentences.en: — And what are they saying?
sentences.zh: — 他们在说些什么？

sentences.en: — A lot of people were posting candle emojis and other kinds of remembrances for Dr. Lee.
sentences.zh: — 很多人都在发蜡烛表情符号以及对李医生的其他各种纪念。

sentences.en: They were posting photos of him.
sentences.zh: 他们在发布他的照片。

sentences.en: He had taken a selfie of himself wearing a surgical mask.
sentences.zh: 他曾拍过一张自己戴着医用口罩的自拍照。

sentences.en: And someone had recreated that image to replace the surgical mask with barbed wire to kind of indicate that he had been muzzled.
sentences.zh: 有人重新制作了那张照片，用铁丝网替换了医用口罩，以此表明他曾被噤声。

sentences.en: Some people were posting the anthem from Les Mis.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至在发布《悲惨世界》的主题曲。

sentences.en: Do you hear the people sing, singing a song of angry men?
sentences.zh: 你听到人们在歌唱吗，唱着愤怒之人的歌？

sentences.en: — Wow.
— We actually saw the hashtag I want freedom of speech trending for five hours, which of course it was quickly censored.
sentences.zh: — 我们实际上看到“我要言论自由”这个话题标签登上了五小时的热搜，当然它很快就被审查了。

sentences.en: And we saw petitions going up by Chinese academics calling for freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 我们看到中国学者发起的呼吁言论自由的请愿书在不断增加。

sentences.en: And we even saw a local government social media account posting a portrait of Dr. Lee along with the lines, heroes don't fall from the sky.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至看到一个地方政府的社交媒体账号发布了李医生的画像，并配文：英雄不从天降。

sentences.en: They're just ordinary people who step forward.
sentences.zh: 他们只是挺身而出的普通人。

sentences.en: — Wow.
— So the reaction is really remarkable.
sentences.zh: — 所以这种反应真的很了不起。

sentences.en: I mean, even the hospital where Dr. Lee died had posted an official notice of his death, and that had three million reactions and 300,000 comments.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，甚至连李医生去世的医院都发布了官方讣告，获得了三百万的互动和三十万条评论。

sentences.en: And so it was so clear that this was something that had really tapped into the frustration that was happening.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这真正触及了人们正在经历的挫败感。

sentences.en: — And what do you make of those reactions?
sentences.zh: — 你对这些反应怎么看？

sentences.en: Because it feels like it no longer is really just about this virus and the way that it was handled.
sentences.zh: 因为感觉这似乎已经不仅仅是关于这个病毒以及它的处理方式了。

sentences.en: — Yeah.
sentences.zh: — 是的。

sentences.en: So at this point, it is clear that this is becoming so much bigger than just the virus.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，很明显，这已经变得远超病毒本身。

sentences.en: This is really about the government and this social contract that the people have had with the government, where they agree to keep silent as long as the government provides for
sentences.zh: 这真正关乎政府以及人民与政府之间达成的这种社会契约，即只要政府保障他们的

sentences.en: their prosperity and health.
sentences.zh: 繁荣与健康，他们就同意保持沉默。

sentences.en: It operates under this principle of stability at all costs.
sentences.zh: 它在不惜一切代价追求稳定这一原则下运作。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: — 没错。

sentences.en: And in their effort to create stability, in fact, they did the opposite.
sentences.zh: 而在他们努力创造稳定的同时，实际上他们却做到了相反的事情。

sentences.en: — Yeah.
sentences.zh: — 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that there's this realization, definitely, that there's something wrong with the system.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为人们绝对意识到这个系统出了问题。

sentences.en: And I don't think that it means that people are going out in the streets and calling for a revolution.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这意味着人们会走上街头呼吁革命。

sentences.en: But the fact that people are calling for freedom of speech, I mean, that's really what this brought out.
sentences.zh: 但人们呼吁言论自由的事实，我的意思是，这正是这件事所引发的。

sentences.en: — People in China already used to a pretty high level of censorship, but when it comes to censoring a warning about public health, that goes too far.
sentences.zh: — 中国的人们已经习惯了相当高水平的审查，但当涉及到审查关于公共健康的警告时，那就太过分了。

sentences.en: And the reaction is so overwhelming that the government quickly realizes that they need to do something.
sentences.zh: 这种反应如此强烈，以至于政府很快意识到他们需要采取行动。

sentences.en: And that's when we see China's leader, Xi Jinping, come forward out of the shadows and try to take control of the situation.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，我们看到中国的领导人习近平从幕后走到台前，试图控制局势。

sentences.en: — He comes out and makes an appearance in Beijing.
sentences.zh: — 他走到幕前并在北京公开露面。

sentences.en: — He visits a community center and a hospital.
sentences.zh: — 他视察了一个社区中心和一家医院。

sentences.en: He gets his temperature taken.
sentences.zh: 他接受了体温检测。

sentences.en: He talks with local residents.
sentences.zh: 他与当地居民交谈。

sentences.en: — And he does a video conference with doctors in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: — 并且他与武汉的医生进行了视频会议。

sentences.en: — So by this point, the government has sent the nation's top anti-corruption agency to go down to
sentences.zh: — 所以在这一点上，政府已经派遣了国家最高反腐败机构前往

sentences.en: Wuhan and investigate Dr. Li's death.
sentences.zh: 武汉调查李医生的死因。

sentences.en: And state media is calling Dr. Li a hero.
sentences.zh: 官方媒体称李医生为英雄。

sentences.en: — This feels like a real shift for a government that originally reprimanded Dr. Li and is now sending a team to investigate why he was muzzled.
sentences.zh: — 对于一个最初训诫李医生、而现在却派调查组去查明他为何被噤声的政府来说，这感觉像是一个真正的转变。

sentences.en: It feels like a concession.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一种让步。

sentences.en: — It is.
sentences.zh: — 的确如此。

sentences.en: But at the same time, we have to remember that this is also part of the party's ethos, which is to always try to control the narrative.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们必须记住，这也是党的一贯精神的一部分，那就是始终试图掌控话语权。

sentences.en: And for them, the path of least resistance in this situation is to hold Dr. Li up as a hero, but also to do it in a way that coheres with the party narrative.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这种情况下阻力最小的途径就是将李医生尊为英雄，但同时也要以一种符合党的话语体系的方式来做。

sentences.en: — Huh.
— Erasing the parts that might challenge their legitimacy or authority, which is the fact that
sentences.zh: — 抹去那些可能挑战他们的合法性或权威的部分，也就是这样一个事实：

sentences.en: he was punished by the government for trying to call attention to the fact that there was this virus going around.
sentences.zh: 他因为试图引起人们对这种正在蔓延的病毒的关注而受到了政府的惩罚。

sentences.en: — Do you think that the people in China view the government's response as an attempt to protect them from the virus or to protect the government from the story of a
sentences.zh: — 你认为中国人民是将政府的反应视为保护他们免受病毒侵害的努力，还是为了保护政府免受失控局面的影响？

sentences.en: situation that's out of control?
sentences.zh: — 两者都有。

sentences.en: — Both.
sentences.zh: 人们确实相信政府希望将这场疫情控制住。

sentences.en: People really believe that the government wants to get this epidemic under control.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们知道政府采取这一行动的前提是不能威胁到其自身的统治权力。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they know that the government is only going to do this in a way that does not threaten its own hold on power.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要掌控话语权，派遣他们自己的记者，确保只突出他们所做事情的积极方面。

sentences.en: And that means taking control of the narrative, sending in their own journalists to make sure that only the positive aspects of what they're doing is being highlighted.
sentences.zh: 而那些被遗漏的人或者政策的所有失败之处则不会被突出报道。

sentences.en: And that people who are slipping through the cracks or all the failures of the policy are not being highlighted.
sentences.zh: — 艾米，我很好奇，自从你撤离后，也就是从武汉坐飞机到加利福尼亚之后，你还能联系到张家吗？

sentences.en: — Amy, I'm curious, have you been able to speak to the Zhang family since you evacuated, since you took that flight from Wuhan to California?
sentences.zh: — 我们联系上了。

sentences.en: — We have.
sentences.zh: 我们最后一次联系他们时，他们的处境已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: The last time we checked in with them, their situation had changed.
sentences.zh: 母亲和女儿都感染了冠状病毒，并终于得以进入政府设立的临时隔离中心之一。

sentences.en: The mother and the daughter were both infected with the coronavirus and have finally been able to get into one of the makeshift quarantine centers set up by the government.
sentences.zh: 女儿贝拉给我们发来了该中心的一段视频。

sentences.en: Bella, the daughter, has sent us a video of the center.
sentences.zh: 画面显示那是一个巨大的展厅，里面摆满了紧密排列的床铺，所有的病人都躺在这些床上。

sentences.en: And it just shows a huge exhibition center with beds crowded tightly together and all these sick patients in these beds.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，贝拉的哥哥和他们的祖母仍然留在家中，待在自家的公寓里，生病却无法住院。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Bella's brother and their grandmother are still at home, back in the family apartment, sick and unable to get into a hospital.
sentences.zh: 祖母的情况非常严重。

sentences.en: The grandmother is in very serious condition.
sentences.zh: 她几乎无法下床。

sentences.en: She can barely get out of bed.
sentences.zh: 他们还和父亲住在一起，父亲是目前唯一没有感染的家庭成员，尽管他们都认为这只是时间问题。

sentences.en: And they're also still living with their father, who is the only family member who hasn't gotten infected so far, though they all think that it will be a matter of time.
sentences.zh: — 所以基本上家里有一半人得到了照顾，而另一半则被抛弃了。

sentences.en: — So basically half the family is being cared for, and the other half have been kind of abandoned.
sentences.zh: — 没错。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: 并且记住，他们的祖父在自家公寓里去世了，并立即被送去火化。

sentences.en: And remember, their grandfather had died in their family apartment and was taken to be cremated immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还不知道他的骨灰在哪里。

sentences.en: And they still don't even know where his ashes are.
sentences.zh: — 家庭中可能会发生另一次死亡的现实，是他们正在做心理准备的事情吗？

sentences.en: — Is the reality that another death in the family could happen something that they are preparing for?
sentences.zh: — 是的，他们一直在为此做准备。

sentences.en: — Yes, they've been planning for it.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，当祖母去世时，他们不会让她去火葬场。

sentences.en: They told us that when the grandmother dies, they're not going to let her go to the crematorium.
sentences.zh: 事实上，母亲说她要把尸体拖到当地的居委会，就放在前台台阶上，以此向他们展示

sentences.en: But actually, the mother said she's going to drag her body to the local neighborhood committee and just put it there on the front steps to show them
sentences.zh: 他们的不作为是如何摧毁了他们整个家庭的。

sentences.en: how their inaction has devastated their entire family.
sentences.zh: — 你知道家人是否知道李医生的死，或者他们是否能看到那段关于

sentences.en: — Do you know whether the family knows about Dr. Li's death, or if they were able to watch that video of
sentences.zh: 习近平公开应对危机的视频？

sentences.en: Xi Jinping in public addressing the situation?
sentences.zh: — 我想即使他们看到了，也没有什么感觉。

sentences.en: — I think if they've seen it, it's barely registered.
sentences.zh: 他们现在满脑子只想活下去，就像武汉的许多其他人一样，他们只能低头试图向前看。

sentences.en: They are so consumed with just trying to survive right now, like so many other people in Wuhan, that they're just putting their heads down trying to move forward.
sentences.zh: — 艾米，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: — Amy, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: — 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: — Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: — 周四，武汉所在的中国省份的确诊病例数新增了近15,000例，

sentences.en: — On Thursday, nearly 15,000 new cases of coronavirus were added to the tally of infected people in the
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止该疫情单日最大增幅。

sentences.en: Chinese province where Wuhan is located, the largest one-day increase of the epidemic so far.
sentences.zh: — 这使得总病例数超过了48,000例。

sentences.en: — That brings the total number of cases to more than 48,000.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，还报告了242例新增死亡病例，使该省的死亡人数达到1,310人。

sentences.en: At the same time, 242 new deaths were also reported, bringing the death toll in the province to 1,310.
sentences.zh: — 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: — 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: — Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: — 连续第二天，特朗普总统干预了他长期以来的朋友和顾问罗杰·斯通的诉讼案，这次是通过抨击该案的法官。

sentences.en: — For the second day in a row, President Trump intervened in the prosecution of his longtime friend and advisor, Roger Stone, this time by attacking the judge in the case.
sentences.zh: 周二，在总统的敦促下，司法部建议对斯通判处更轻的刑期，

sentences.en: On Tuesday, at the president's urging, the Department of Justice recommended a more lenient
sentences.zh: 斯通因阻挠国会调查俄罗斯干预2016年大选而被定罪。

sentences.en: prison sentence for Stone, who was convicted of obstructing a congressional investigation into Russian meddling in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: — 这一举动促使四名联邦检察官抗议离职。

sentences.en: — That move prompted four federal prosecutors to leave the case in proteSt.
sentences.zh: — 周三，特朗普在推特上毫无根据地宣称，将对斯通进行判决的法官

sentences.en: — On Wednesday, Trump claimed without evidence in a tweet that the judge who will sentence Stone
sentences.zh: 对总统抱有偏见，民主党议员称这显然是企图在法官对斯通宣判前进行恐吓。

sentences.en: is biased against the president in what Democratic lawmakers said was a clear attempt to intimidate the judge before she sentences Stone.
sentences.zh: — 总统竞选时反对华盛顿的政治沼泽，那是一个游戏规则被当权者操纵以谋取私利的地方。

sentences.en: — The president ran against the swamp in Washington, a place where the game is rigged by the powerful, to benefit them personally.
sentences.zh: 我问我的美国同胞们，什么更像沼泽？

sentences.en: I asked my fellow Americans, what is more swampy?
sentences.zh: 什么更令人作呕？

sentences.en: What is more fetid?
sentences.zh: 有什么比这个国家最有权势的人公然修改规则来庇护一个知法犯法的亲信更令人发指的呢？

sentences.en: What is more stinking than the most powerful person in the country, literally changing the rules to benefit a crony guilty of breaking the law?
sentences.zh: — 作为回应，参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默呼吁对特朗普的行为展开调查。

sentences.en: — In response, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer called for an investigation into Trump's conduct.
sentences.zh: — 因此，我已正式请求司法部总监察长立即对这一事件展开调查。

sentences.en: — As a result, I have formally requested that the Inspector General of the Justice Department investigate this matter immediately.
sentences.zh: — 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: — 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: — For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都会》节目中，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却最终失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
